projects.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI ready knowledge graphs. projects.name: agent-desktop
projects.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. agent desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. Install Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. projects.readmeExcerpt: agent browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew: brew install agent browser , then agent browser install . Linux: agent browser install with deps also installs the browser's system libraries.
